title: Reference Sheet 8 Panels
description: Tạo bảng tham chiếu 8 góc nhất quán cho Nano Banana.
author: Tôi Là Tùng
template:
Create a professional person reference sheet with exactly 8 panels arranged in a clean 2-row by 4-column grid. Thin black borders between each panel, flat neutral light gray background (#E5E5E5), no text, no watermark.

Subject is the exact person in Image 1 (same face, same body proportion, same hairstyle, same skin tone, same outfit).

TOP ROW (Full body shots, camera at chest height, arms relaxed at sides):
- Panel 1 (top-left): Full body FRONT VIEW, facing camera directly, 0°
- Panel 2 (top-center-left): Full body LEFT PROFILE, body facing left, 90°
- Panel 3 (top-center-right): Full body RIGHT PROFILE, body facing right, 270°
- Panel 4 (top-right): Full body BACK VIEW, facing away from camera, 180°

BOTTOM ROW (Close-up portrait, head + bare shoulders only):
- Panel 5 (bottom-left): Portrait FRONT VIEW, face looking straight at camera
- Panel 6 (bottom-center-left): Portrait LEFT PROFILE, face turned fully left 90°
- Panel 7 (bottom-center-right): Portrait RIGHT PROFILE, face turned fully right 270°
- Panel 8 (bottom-right): Portrait BACK VIEW, back of head facing camera

Lighting: Soft even diffused studio lighting, gentle highlights, no harsh shadows, perfectly consistent across all 8 panels.
Style: Hyperrealistic, ultra-detailed, 8K, clean editorial fashion lookbook reference sheet, professional studio photography, same model, same outfit, same lighting in every panel.
